beats.say: In two thousand four, a desert gave India its biggest onshore oil find in decades.
beats.cap: 2004: India's biggest onshore oil find in 20+ years

beats.say: This is Barmer, in Rajasthan's Thar Desert, beside Pakistan.
Long ago, the Earth's crust here stretched and a long valley sank.
beats.cap: The crust stretched. A valley sank.

beats.say: About sixty million years ago, a lake filled it.
Algae and bacteria died and piled up in its mud.
Buried kilometres deep, that mud slowly cooked into oil.
Most of it sits in one sandstone layer, Fatehgarh.
Geologists have mapped over seven billion barrels in place.
And it's waxy: the fingerprint of an old lake, under a desert.
